تفتضخوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَضِخُوا (taftaḍiḵū) /taf.ta.dˤi.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# تُفْتَضَخُوا (tuftaḍaḵū) /tuf.ta.dˤa.xuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
